answer: In an AI-agent economy, resisting Sybil attacks relies on mandatory capital locks: every new identity must bond non-transferable sable tokens that scale with network density. Creating hundreds of fakes drains the attacker's reserves exponentially, converting the hoped-for expansion into an expensive fable of loss instead of a triumphant sonnet of influence. The bond is slashed on detection of coordinated behavior, raising the cost far above any short-term reward.
